anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The candidate paper title and abstract explicitly describe the curation and release of the P300-based BCI dataset, matching the dataset's content.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 20 healthy subjects at a sampling rate of 256 Hz using 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage. Recordings were obtained using g.USBamp hardware (g.tec) with a 60 Hz line frequency. Subjects performed a visual P300 speller task using a 9x8 checkerboard paradigm with dynamic stimulus presentation. Each subject completed one session with target and non-target visual stimuli presented in a calibration-then-test cross-validation design.
